text:
Priya: Heads-up — heard from a PM that users get confused when they hit "Save as preview" in the route inspector. It sometimes binds to the ephemeral session instead of creating a persistent saved query.
Ethan: Ah yeah — the button text is ambiguous. UX currently: Save / Save as preview / Export.
Lara: Repro steps? I thought preview is intentionally session-scoped for quick compares.
Priya: Steps: open route A -> adjust model filter to model:v2 -> toggle compact sampling -> click Save as preview -> switch to route B -> open saved views -> preview not visible in route B (user expects it to be).
Sam: That's because previews are attached to the active session id + route id in the backend. We intentionally scoped it to avoid polluting savedquery table with ephemeral drafts.
Ethan: But PM says some power users expect a lightweight saved query that follows them across routes (cross-route quickfilters). We need to decide ownership model.
Lara: Options: (1) Keep session-scoped previews but change label to "Save temporary view (session)"; (2) Add a checkbox "Make portable" that writes a persistent savedquery + marks it ephemeral; (3) auto-prompt on route switch "Do you want to persist this preview?".
Priya: Also telemetry: we currently only log savedquery.create for persistent saves. Previews have an event but no sample context. PM wants to measure conversion preview->persist.
Sam: We can emit: preview.create, preview.apply, preview.persist with sample_rate and route_id + model_pin. Should be lightweight.
Ethan: Concern: quotas & billing. If previews are portable and get shared across routes, they might trigger users to run heavier telemetry-backed previews that count against sampling buckets. Need to ensure previews don't accidentally trigger cost-incurring workloads (e.g., deep compare snapshots).
Lara: Implementation detail: server currently keys previews by session_id and route_id: previews:{session}:{route} -> JSON. To make portable we'd need previews:{session}:global or persist -> savedqueries table. DB migration surface is small but need ACL decision.
Priya: From UX POV I prefer explicit action. Change label + add small "Make portable" toggle. That avoids breaking current mental model.
Sam: Ok. From infra: adding telemetry events is trivial. But if we add "Make portable" and write to savedqueries we need to run an owner assignment flow: who owns it? user? team? route? Default to user with dotting metadata.
Ethan: Edge case: if portable preview references a model that is pinned per-route (model:v2), and route B pins model:v3, what should happen when user applies portable preview on route B? Overlay should warn and fallback. We should add conflict hint: "This preview references model:v2 which differs from model pinned on this route (v3). Apply anyway?"
Lara: Agreed — add a small banner when model mismatch. Also add telemetry tag mismatch=true so we can track if users mostly overwrite or abandon.
Priya: Can we sketch the telemetry schema quickly so analytics can answer PM's question on conversion? Something like: event: preview.persist { session_id, user_id, route_origin, route_apply_target, model_refs, persisted_id, sample_rate } and preview.apply { session_id, user_id, route_apply_target, model_refs, mismatch:boolean }
Sam: Yep. We'll include cost_bucket and is_portable flags. sample_rate default null for persisted saves.
Ethan: Rollout plan: 1) change label + add telemetry for two weeks, 2) add "Make portable" toggle behind feature flag, 3) if telemetry shows >10% conversion from preview->persist, consider making portable default.
Priya: Perf note: savedquery table has index on owner_id and route_id; portable previews will have owner_id but route_id NULL — ensure queries for per-route list still show both route-specific and global portable ones. Product wants global portable ones shown in a separate "Portable previews" section.
Lara: Also add API contract: GET /routes/:id/savedviews?include_portable=true returns array of savedviews with field scope=(route|portable|global). We'll need to add scope to savedquery schema.
Sam: I'll add backend PR outline and telemetry events. ETA for label change + telemetry: EOW. Toggle + API next sprint.
Priya: Thanks — I'll loop in PM and design for the banner copy.
console-bot: Reminder: UX copy review meeting tomorrow 09:30 — @Priya @Lara @Ethan
Priya: Ack. Thanks everyone.
